title: Ten-pointed stars of the shrine of Zayn al-Din, Tayabad
subtitle: Shrine of Zayn al-Din, Tayabad, Iran

given.O: The centre of a ten-pointed star.
given.A: A point to the right of O. The star’s lines touch the circle through A.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s F66B drawing, whose pieces are drawn edge to edge. O is the centre of a ten-pointed star made of two regular pentagons, and OA is the distance from O to the star’s lines. The repeat is a rectangle of half-sides 3 + √5 and 1/sin 36° (in OA), with a second kind of star at its corners. Every line runs at 90° to the star’s radius at A, B, C and on round, and every offset, fitted as (a + b√5)/c, lies within 0.0007 of OA of the drawing. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. Colours follow the shapes, not his drawing. No photograph was checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data13/F66B: Shrine of Zayn al-Din, Tayabad, Iran
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His reference is El-Said and Parman, Geometric Concepts in Islamic Art (1976), figure 66b, plate 35 (shrine of Zayn al-Din, Tayabad, Iran).

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. It crosses the horizontal line again at F.
Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at N.
Draw a circle with centre F through O. It crosses the first circle at Y1 and Y2. Draw a straight line through Y1 and Y2. It crosses the horizontal line at M, halfway from O to F.
Draw a circle with centre M through N. It crosses the horizontal line at R.

Draw a circle with centre A and opening from O to R. It crosses the circle at B and K. Draw circles of the same size round the circle, each centred where the last one crosses it. They mark C, D, E, G, H and J. The circle is now cut into ten.
Draw a line through A at 90° to the horizontal line. Turn it round O by 36°, nine times. These ten lines touch the circle at A, B, C and on round, and make the ten-pointed star.

The star lines through B and E cross at Y, on the vertical line. Draw a horizontal line through Y. Turn it round O by 180°. The star lines through A and B cross at X. Draw a straight line through O and X. It crosses the horizontal line through Y at K1. Draw a vertical line through K1. Turn it round O by 180°. The four lines make the tile, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.

Draw a straight line through O and E, and a straight line through O and B. Draw a line through Y parallel to line OE. It crosses the horizontal line through O at Z. Reflect line YZ in the horizontal line through O. Turn both lines round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a line through Y parallel to the line from O to E. It crosses the horizontal line through O at Z. Reflect line YZ in the horizontal line through O.

steps.text: Draw a line through Z parallel to the star line through B. Line OX crosses the mirror image of line YZ at P1. Draw a vertical line through P1. Draw a line through P1 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.

The line through P1 parallel to the star line through B crosses the top side of the tile at P2. Draw a line through P2 parallel to the star line through E. It crosses line OX at P3. Draw a line through P3 parallel to the star line through C. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.

Draw a horizontal line through X. It crosses the line through P2 and P3 at P4. Draw a vertical line through P4. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a horizontal line through X. It crosses the line through P2 and P3 at P4. Draw a vertical line through P4. Turn it round O by 180°.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal line through P3. It crosses line YZ at P5. Draw a line through P5 parallel to the star line through C. It crosses the horizontal line through X at P6. Draw a vertical line through P6. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the stars, the pentagons and the pieces between them.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side. A ten-pointed star sits at the centre and at each corner of every tile.
